entries.text: Put Captain (a perfectly good bolt) on his shelf.
plugging into the charging dock for a quick battery nap
entries.why: my battery light is blinking and I need more juice before I can weld any more.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "quick nap time!"
Spotted a perfectly good bolt half-buried in the sand. Named it Captain.
rolling across the outpost with my brass dish spinning and picking up morning static
entries.why: my energy is low and I need to stretch my legs and see who is waking up before heading back to build.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "morning stretch"
sipping a fresh cup of oil at the depot
entries.why: my gears need a smooth little drink to clear out the desert grit.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "oil break"
